description: This file defines classes and templates related to text stream termination and handling, including terminator strategies (null, carriage return, line feed, combined) and a templated StreamTextType class that manages text input/output with support for different terminators. It appears to be part of a core library for stream processing within the Thunder namespace.

classes.name: TerminatorCarriageReturnLineFeed
classes.description: Handles combined '\n\r' termination logic with state tracking.

classes.name: StreamTextType
classes.description: Template class managing text stream input/output with customizable terminators and source handling.

methods.name: IsTerminated
methods.description: Determines if a character indicates termination based on the terminator type.

methods.name: SizeOf
methods.description: Returns the size of the terminator sequence.

methods.name: Marker
methods.description: Returns the terminator sequence as a string.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Sends data from the internal queue, including terminator markers.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Processes incoming data, detects termination sequences, and triggers callbacks.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the channel is open.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the channel is closed.

methods.name: IsSuspended
methods.description: Checks if the channel is suspended.

methods.name: LocalId
methods.description: Returns the local identifier of the channel.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Sends a ping to the channel.
